positive_snippets: I and my colleagues stayed at Silver Oak Hotel for 3 days and it gave us excellent business facilities. Our rooms had proper office desks and chairs and all the necessary things. I appreciated it. This hotel felt like a natural home away from home. I was so impressed with the level of comfort and attention to detail. My stay was perfect.

I stayed here for 4 nights and found this place worth writing a review. Spacious room  with balcony, neat and clean laundry are worth mentioning. Hot breakfast in the morning provided stimulus for the day. Before retiring for the day around 10 PM, ordered Masala Dosa and to my surprise they surved crispy dosa with sumptuous sambhar and chutney. Staff is very well behaved. On the checkout date they served sattu parath, which made me convince that I have to come back again with family to have a homely stay with sumptuous food.
I personally recommend you to try this place once.

The staff at this hotel SILVER OAK were incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout our stay. The rooms were Clean and very comfortable. We also enjoyed the delicious breakfast each morning and loved the convenient location close to major attractions."
